name: jali-repo
description: Jali's workspace root: the published package `jali` (packages/jali), built from @jali/core and @jali/react (packages/, private), the docs site (apps/docs), the example apps (examples/) and the repo's tooling (tooling/). See docs/BRIEF.md.
author: Ramiz Rahman (https://ramizrahman.com/)

scripts.build: tsc -b && vp build examples/data-studio && vp build examples/loan-review
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/docs && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/type-tests && tsc --noEmit -p packages/jali/type-tests
scripts.test: vp test run && vp test run --config apps/docs/src/reference/vitest.config.ts && node tooling/docs-check.mjs && node tooling/agent-docs.mjs --check
scripts.size: pnpm build:packages && tsc -p tooling/size && node tooling/size.mjs
